text: The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews and recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board.

City Council on June 8 and 9, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Tamara Balan to the Toronto Public Library Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on November 14, 2022, and until a successor is appointed. 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1, 2, 3 and 4 to the report (April 28, 2021) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board. Confidential Attachments 1, 2, 3 and 4 to the report (April 28, 2021) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Public Library Board.
